entries.zh: 当；迎面挡住、顶住，对面应对
entries.en: to face or confront head-on; to withstand, take the brunt
entries.notes: L『afechar, hacer embocada』与汉字『當』（对、顶）大义相合，但 embocada 具体所指及 M 栏四音节后半（cūy chāy lāy）无法落实，故中等置信。

entries.en: to look after, attend to; take care of
entries.notes: 以汉字『照料』与官话对音 chiān liāo 定释义；西语栏 afechar/ladron/caçador 与之不合，疑为条目错位或他义附注。

entries.zh: 暗静看；偷偷窥看、暗地里瞧
entries.en: to watch secretly, spy on slyly; peep at from hiding

entries.zh: 对人做鬼脸、挤眉弄眼地打暗号（以脚、头、手、尾示意）
entries.en: to make signs or wink at someone with the feet, head and hands; to signal covertly with gestures
entries.notes: L 栏西语截断（mirandole lasi da-），据汉字『却脚头手尾』与 guiñar（挤眼示意）义推断为以身体各部示意。

entries.zh: 偷偷慢看；偷觑、缓缓偷瞧一眼
entries.en: to steal a slow glance; peek at stealthily and deliberately
entries.notes: 汉字栏『蛮』有 [疑:蠻] 标记，四栏大义（afechar despacio＝慢慢看）可互证，细节存疑故降中等。

entries.en: to glance askew; flash a sideways look
to comfort, reassure; put at ease
to comfort the heart, console; set the mind at rest

entries.zh: 慰服；安抚劝服、使其平静
entries.en: to soothe and calm; console and quiet someone
to settle or put down in place; fix by arranging
ancestor, forefather; progenitor
ancestors of old; former generations

entries.zh: 祖地；祖先故地、祖籍之地
entries.en: ancestral land, place of the forebears

entries.zh: 祖宗；宗族先祖、家族之本
entries.en: ancestors, the stock or trunk of the family line
grandfather; aged ancestor, patriarch
to sit, sit down; take a seat
to hang up, fix in place by hanging; settle

entries.zh: 挂转头；扭头转回、翻转过来
entries.en: to turn the head about; turn it round and round, reverse

entries.zh: 垫放于下以支撑；物下垫承（汉字『亏』疑为借字或残字）
entries.en: to put something underneath so it may be supported; prop up from below
entries.notes: 西语义清晰（poner algo debaxo paraque apoyese），但汉字『亏』与对音 guēng: gīong 未能对应常见汉字，字面存疑故降中等。

entries.zh: 予其自在；放任不管、听其随意
entries.en: to let it be at ease, give it free rein; leave it alone
entries.notes: 『号』疑为『乎/放』之借写，据乞伊自在（给它自由自在）四音节与西语『放之于下』的安顿义折中定释义。

entries.en: to saw, cut with a saw
